title: AEOeye vs Trakkr: One-Off Audit or Daily Monitoring?
metaTitle: AEOeye vs Trakkr: Which Should You Use? (2026)
metaDescription: AEOeye vs Trakkr, honestly: a free ChatGPT check and $29 five-engine report versus Trakkr's daily tracking from $100 a month. Who should pick which.
shortAnswer: Choose Trakkr if you need to watch how AI engines name your brand every day and someone will act on it weekly; it starts at $100 a month for one brand. Choose AEOeye if you want to know once, cheaply, whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity recommend you: a free ChatGPT check, then a $29 one-time report. AEOeye is not monitoring.
intro:
This comparison is based on public documentation as of October 2026: Trakkr's pricing page, billing guide, FAQ and terms. We have not used Trakkr hands-on, and AEOeye is our own product, so read our claims about it with that in mind. Everything about Trakkr below comes from Trakkr's own pages and is dated; everything about AEOeye is what we ship.

The two answer different questions. Trakkr answers "how is our AI visibility moving?" AEOeye answers "are we visible at all, and who is named instead?" Most readers need the second answer first.

sections.heading: Which should you choose, AEOeye or Trakkr?
sections.body:
Choose by the question you are asking. If it is "do AI engines recommend us at all?", run AEOeye once. If it is "is our share of AI answers rising, and who moved?", you need a daily tracker, and Trakkr is built for that job.

- **Pick AEOeye if** you have never read what the five engines say about you, you want a fixed price, or you want to see who gets named instead of you.
- **Pick Trakkr if** you already know AI answers affect your sales, someone will open the dashboard every week, and you need trends and eight models rather than a snapshot.
- **Use both, in that order:** [run the free audit](/) first, subscribe to a tracker only if the gap is worth watching.

Our position: paying $1,000 a year for a trend line you have never looked at once is the common mistake. Look first, then subscribe.

sections.heading: What is each tool built for?
sections.body:
Trakkr monitors; AEOeye diagnoses once. Trakkr's [FAQ](https://trakkr.ai/learn/docs/faq) says it sends each tracked prompt to the model providers' own APIs every day and records which brands each answer names, and in what order. AEOeye asks buyer questions once and shows you the answers.

Beyond the daily scores, Trakkr's documentation describes citation tracking, perception analysis, competitor discovery, a page-by-page action pipeline and an assistant it calls the Agent. It tracks eight models: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Meta AI and Google AI Overviews.

AEOeye's free audit asks ChatGPT three unbranded buyer questions live and shows the full answers, the competitors named instead of you and starter fixes. The [$29 report](/pricing) adds Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity, ten questions instead of three, a five-layer SEO foundation audit and a fix roadmap by PDF. Each engine is tested at the default tier a free user would get; [how it works](/how-it-works).

Both sit under what [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_engine_optimization) calls generative engine optimization, also known as answer engine optimization (AEO).

sections.heading: How do AEOeye and Trakkr compare side by side?
sections.body: They differ on price, cadence and depth. The table sets the documented facts next to each other. Trakkr figures are US dollars from its [pricing page](https://trakkr.ai/pricing) and [billing guide](https://trakkr.ai/learn/docs/account/billing), checked on 2026-10-03, before tax. Add-ons and annual maths are in our [Trakkr pricing breakdown](/blog/trakkr-pricing).

sections.heading: Where is Trakkr stronger?
sections.body:
Trakkr is stronger at everything that needs repetition: trends, coverage, volume and workflow. If your question is "what changed since last month?", a one-off report cannot answer it.

**Repeated sampling.** SparkToro's study of 2,961 runs across ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI found [under a 1 in 100 chance](https://sparktoro.com/blog/new-research-ais-are-highly-inconsistent-when-recommending-brands-or-products-marketers-should-take-care-when-tracking-ai-visibility/) that ChatGPT or Google's AI repeats the same brand list, and its author suggests asking 60 to 100 times and averaging. Daily runs give Trakkr about 30 samples per prompt per month; one AEOeye run is one sample.

**Volume.** Trakkr counts a data point as one query to one model. Growth lists [12,000 data points](https://trakkr.ai/pricing) a month, which is 50 prompts times 8 models times 30 days. At $100 that is under one cent each (our arithmetic); AEOeye's 50 answers for $29 cost 58 cents each, once.

**Coverage and workflow.** Grok, DeepSeek and Meta AI are tracked; AEOeye covers five engines. Trakkr also offers [MCP access, CSV and Sheets export](https://trakkr.ai/learn/docs/account/billing), and on Scale a REST API and white-label client portals.

**Exit terms.** New subscribers get a [14-day money-back guarantee](https://trakkr.ai/terms).

sections.heading: Where is AEOeye stronger?
sections.body:
AEOeye is stronger at the first question: it costs the least to find out where you stand. The ChatGPT audit is free, and the five-engine report is $29 once, with no subscription to cancel.

![Close-up of a checklist with green checkmarks on white paper](https://images.pexels.com/photos/11412596/pexels-photo-11412596.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

- **No card on a clock.** Trakkr's [14-day trial needs a card](https://trakkr.ai/learn/docs/account/billing) and converts to $100 a month unless you cancel.
- **Engines at the default tier.** We test each engine at the tier your buyers get for free, not a stronger one.
- **A fix list, not only a score.** The report ends with a roadmap and a five-layer SEO foundation audit.

The honest limit: AEOeye shows a snapshot, not a trend. It cannot tell you whether last month's fix worked. Treat absence as the strong signal. If you are missing from every engine across several questions, that is robust; a single "named third" is one sample, not a rank. Re-run after you change something.

sections.heading: What does a year cost with each tool?
sections.body:
A year of Trakkr Growth costs $1,000 on annual billing or $1,200 paid monthly; AEOeye's report is $29 once. They buy different things: Trakkr's price covers 365 daily runs of 50 prompts across eight models, ours covers one run of ten questions across five engines.

Two details change the Trakkr bill. Annual plans are [charged upfront and renew automatically](https://trakkr.ai/terms). Extra brands cost $50 a month and extra prompts $39 to $99 a month per brand, per its billing guide.

One tip applies to any tracker: Trakkr's FAQ advises starting with 5 to 20 questions your buyers really ask, not all 50. Fewer, sharper prompts are easier to read, and you can grow once you see what moves.

sections.heading: Which tool fits a solo founder, an in-house team or an agency?
sections.body:
A solo founder or small shop should start with AEOeye, an in-house team with a weekly routine can justify Trakkr, and an agency should price Trakkr's Scale plan against its client count.

- **Solo founder or small business:** run the audit, fix the obvious gaps, and only then ask whether daily tracking is worth $1,000 a year.
- **In-house marketing team:** if AI answers already feed your pipeline, Trakkr's dashboard, citation data and actions suit a standing weekly review.
- **Agency:** Scale lists ten brands, unlimited seats, an API and white-label portals; AEOeye has none of that. For a prospect pitch, a one-off AEOeye report is a cheaper opener.

sections.heading: What did we see on Trakkr's own site?
sections.body:
We saw an open door for AI crawlers. This is a neutral fact box from AEOeye's [crawler access study](/resources/ai-crawler-access-study-2026-10.json), one fetch on 2026-10-03, not a verdict on the product.

![Modern laptop on a wooden desk displaying analytical software](https://images.pexels.com/photos/34803995/pexels-photo-34803995.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

- trakkr.ai's robots.txt names ten AI bots, including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, and allows all of them.
- It publishes an llms.txt file.
- Its server-rendered homepage carries JSON-LD including FAQPage, Offer and SoftwareApplication.

The aeoeye.com row in the same study looks alike: no AI bot blocked, six named, an llms.txt file, FAQPage and SoftwareApplication schema. Both vendors practise what they sell. Method and numbers: [AI crawler directory](/blog/ai-crawler-user-agent-directory).

keyTakeaways: Trakkr is a daily monitor: eight models, 50 prompts per brand, from $100 a month (Growth, one brand), with a 14-day card-required trial.
AEOeye is a one-off diagnosis: a free three-question ChatGPT audit, then a $29 one-time report covering ten questions on five engines.
Trakkr is stronger on trends, repeated sampling, volume and agency features; AEOeye is stronger on cost of a first answer and no commitment.
One snapshot is one sample, so read AEOeye's results as where you are absent, not as an exact rank.
Look first, subscribe second: run the audit, then pay for tracking only if the gap is worth watching.

faqs.q: Is AEOeye a replacement for Trakkr?
faqs.a: No. They do different jobs. Trakkr tracks your brand across eight models every day and shows trends. AEOeye is a one-off audit: a free ChatGPT check and a $29 report across five engines. Use AEOeye to learn where you stand, and a tracker only if you need to watch the gap over time.

faqs.q: How much does Trakkr cost compared with AEOeye?
faqs.a: As of October 2026, Trakkr Growth is $100 a month ($1,000 billed annually) for one brand, and Scale is $500 a month for ten, before tax. AEOeye's audit is free for ChatGPT and the five-engine report is $29 once. They are not like-for-like: one buys continuous tracking, the other a snapshot.

faqs.q: Does Trakkr have a free plan?
faqs.a: No. Trakkr's FAQ says there is no free version: it runs a 14-day Growth trial that needs a card and charges nothing until the trial ends. After that every plan is paid. AEOeye's free audit runs three buyer questions on ChatGPT only; Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity are in the $29 report.

faqs.q: Can I use AEOeye and Trakkr together?
faqs.a: Yes, and in that order works well. Run the AEOeye audit to see whether AI engines name you and who they name instead. If the gap matters and someone will act on weekly data, add a tracker such as Trakkr to watch it move. Skip the subscription if the audit shows nothing worth tracking.

faqs.q: Is one audit enough to trust the result?
faqs.a: For absence, often yes; for rank, no. SparkToro found AI tools almost never repeat the same brand list, so a single run is one sample. If you are missing from every engine across several questions, that signal is strong. Re-run after changes, or use a daily tracker for trends.
